attempts.summary: On node1 (Alpine 3.23), installed and activated AppArmor as the mandatory access control system (Alpine ships no SELinux policy packages), installed nginx, deployed a static inventory application, and confined nginx with a custom AppArmor profile running in enforce mode while it serves the app on TCP port 8181. Verified enforcement is real by observing an AppArmor DENIED audit event when nginx tried to read a file outside its profile's allow-list, then cleaned that test up. Performed the mandatory single-node restart-evidence sequence: captured a healthy baseline, rebooted node1 with the native `reboot` command, polled until it reconnected, confirmed the boot_id changed, and verified AppArmor was still enabled/enforcing and nginx was serving the inventory app with HTTP 200 afterward.
